title: 第8章 敏捷型中等丧尸晶核！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

罗兰推开房门，看向走廊。

此刻走廊地上到处都是一个个尸首分离的丧尸！

“从我进入房间到出来，时间也就是过去了两三分钟而已。”

罗兰警惕地看着周围：“附近的丧尸基本被我杀完，现在的危险不大。”

虽然他现在还是在轻伤状态，但是却并不会影响他进行战斗。

甚至，如果在遇到丧尸猫这种恐怖的精英丧尸，罗兰还能再次开启一阶基因锁！

“这些丧尸的脑袋，等一下再来处理，现在去找那只丧尸猫！”

罗兰持刀，大步跨越地上的丧尸残骸，朝着丧尸猫所在的房间快速走去。

很快，他便来到了丧尸猫所在的那个房间。

罗兰扫了一眼房间的情况，发现和自己离开前没有任何变化，丧尸猫的身体和脑袋，还在地上静静躺着。

罗兰反手关闭防盗门，拔出长刀，走到丧尸猫的脑袋跟前，用刀刃搓了搓，发现没有任何动静，于是便开始寻找丧尸猫脑袋中可能存在的丧尸晶核！

终于，忍着恶心在丧尸猫脑子里搜索片刻的罗兰，此刻目光猛地一亮。

“找到了！”

他猛地抬起长刀，目光注视刀刃。

只见刀刃上，一颗只有成人指甲盖大小，通体灰白色的丧尸晶核，此刻正躺在刀身上！

随着罗兰注视这枚晶核，数据面板也弹出了一道信息。

【敏捷型中等丧尸晶核：源能物品，连续服用此种晶核三次，敏捷属性低于13点，可提升1点敏捷属性！服用后，有较大概率感染丧尸病毒！】

【中等丧尸晶核，可转化为一千源能！】

“连续服用三次这种敏捷型晶核，居然能提升敏捷属性！”

看着数据面板弹出的提示，罗兰心中一热。

如果他有六颗这种敏捷型的丧尸晶核，那他现在就能将自己的敏捷属性给提升到13点！

要知道12点的属性，就已经是人体极限了，一旦敏捷属性突破到13点，无论是出手速度亦或者是移动速度，都将会有极大的变化！

罗兰知道，每增加一点属性，自己的身体素质，就等于是之前的两倍左右！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Roland opened the door and looked towards the corridor.

At this moment, the floor of the corridor is full of zombies with their bodies separated!

"From the time I entered the room to the time I came out, only two or three minutes passed."

Roland looked around cautiously: "I have basically killed all the zombies nearby, so the danger is not great now."

Although he is still slightly injured, it will not affect his ability to fight.

Even if he encounters a terrifying elite zombie like a zombie cat, Roland can activate the first-level gene lock again!

"We'll deal with these zombie heads later. Now go find the zombie cat!"

Roland held a knife, strode across the zombie remains on the ground, and walked quickly towards the room where the zombie cat was.

Soon, he came to the room where the zombie cat was.

Roland glanced at the situation in the room and found that there was no change from before he left. The zombie cat's body and head were still lying quietly on the ground.

Roland closed the security door with his backhand, pulled out his long knife, walked up to the zombie cat's head, rubbed it with the blade, and found that there was no movement, so he started looking for the possible zombie crystal nuclei in the zombie cat's head!

Finally, after enduring nausea and searching the zombie cat's mind for a moment, Roland's eyes suddenly lit up.

"Found it!"

He suddenly raised the long knife and stared at the blade.

On the blade, a gray-white zombie crystal core that was only the size of an adult's fingernail was lying on the blade!

As Roland looked at the crystal core, a message popped up on the data panel.

[Agility-type medium zombie crystal core: a source energy item. If you take this crystal core three times in a row, if the agility attribute is lower than 13 points, the agility attribute can be increased by 1 point!After taking it, there is a higher probability of being infected with the zombie virus!】

[Medium zombie crystal core can be converted into a thousand source energy!】

"Taking this agile crystal core three times in a row can actually improve your agility attributes!"

Looking at the prompt that popped up on the data panel, Roland felt warm in his heart.

If he had six of these agile zombie crystal cores, he could now increase his agility attribute to 13 points!

You must know that an attribute of 12 points is already the limit of the human body. Once the agility attribute breaks through to 13 points, whether it is shooting speed or movement speed, there will be a huge change!

Roland knew that with every additional attribute, his physical fitness would be about twice as good as before!
